event_name: Date 27 October 2018 Time 11:53 2018 MEXICAN GRAND PRIX 25 - 28 October 2018 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Car 18 failed to follow the Race Director's Instruction in Turn 8.
offence: Breach of Article 12.1.1 i. of the FIA International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed the video evidence and heard from the driver of car 18 (Lance Stroll) and team representative. The driver did not keep wholly to the right of the fluorescent yellow kerb after he had passed completely behind the T8 apex kerb. The Stewards accept that as the track conditions were damp and as the driver was on slick tyres he took the appropriate action in the circumstances. Additionally, no other car was in the vicinity of car 18 at the time of the incident.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Doc 23 2018 Mexican Grand Prix Decision Car 18 Turn 8 Incident
